0022600198.text: The Timberwolves host the Utah Jazz at 6-3 and on a two-game winning streak, sitting 3rd in the Northwest and 8th in the West, while the Jazz are 1-7, have lost six straight, and sit 14th in the West. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 win over Utah in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
